feeds.title: u-student Blog
feeds.description: U-Student aims to provide students with an unforgettable University experience. Explore our locations and find your ideal student room, designed with you in mind. Quality accommodation, a friendly community, and a safe environment are what make, year-on-year, U-Student a leading provider of student accommodation. Our blog contains reviews, advice, and news for students.

feeds.title: Cardiff University Student Blog
feeds.description: Find out what life at the university is really like from our students. We are an ambitious and innovative university with a bold and strategic vision located in a beautiful and thriving capital city. Our vision is to be a world-leading, research-excellent, educationally outstanding university, driven by creativity and curiosity, which fulfills its social, cultural, and economic obligations to Cardiff, Wales, the UK, and the world.

feeds.title: Bournemouth University Student Blog
feeds.description: Our blogs and vlogs are produced by students, for prospective students, to reflect topics in which students will be interested. Our purpose is to inspire learning, advance knowledge, and enrich society. We proudly celebrate diversity, equality, and inclusivity in the community.

feeds.title: Brighton Student Bloggers
feeds.description: Students from the University of Brighton use this space to blog about their student experience, sharing everything from applying to the university and moving away from home, to studying here, local life, and making friends. They share their top tips and advice to help you prepare for student life.

feeds.title: University of York Blog » Student voices
feeds.description: Get the inside student view on life at York, the fun stuff, and the challenges! Our students will tell you about why they love York and about how they're adapting to university and academic life.

feeds.title: Biology, Medicine and Health Student Blog
feeds.description: This blog is run by the Communications, Marketing, and Student Recruitment team at the Faculty of Biology, Medicine, and Health, The University of Manchester. We publish posts written by and interviews with our students and graduates to help you see what it's like to study on biology, medicine and health courses.

feeds.title: Student Minds Blog
feeds.description: The Student Minds blog is the UK's biggest blog on student well-being and mental health, sharing student experiences of mental health difficulties. Student Minds is the UK's student mental health charity. We empower students and members of the university community to look after their mental health, support others and create change. We share posts so that students can better understand mental health.

feeds.title: University of Birmingham
feeds.description: This blog has been made to be the one-stop-shop for anyone who currently studies in College or for those considering studying one of our subjects shortly. Learn about things such as what it's like to do a placement year during your studies, pick up some great advice and tips and get an insight into all the amazing opportunities there are for Engineering and Physical Sciences students at Birmingham.

feeds.title: Worcester Student Life
feeds.description: We are current students at the University of Worcester, sharing our university experiences and tips on student life. If you want to know what it's like to live and study in Worcester, this is the place to find out.

feeds.title: The Warwick Careers Blog
feeds.description: Articles on topics such as career development, learning, job market, job interviews, career decisions, interview questions, applications, self-awareness, personal branding, work experience, and more. Warwick is one of the UK's leading universities, with an acknowledged reputation for excellence in research and teaching, for innovation, and links with business and industry.

feeds.title: Save the Student
feeds.description: The student money website is designed by keeping students in mind. It offers advice on finance, good deals, banking, accommodation, news, and much more. Get the latest student discounts, student jobs, make-money ideas, and more.

feeds.title: The Student Social Work Hub Blog
feeds.description: At present we are a small team of seven friends whilst focusing on the academic aspects of social work, we also want to promote self-care and ensure that we maintain a relaxed outlook on student life. We aim to share blogs, articles, webinars, platforms, and academic writing in ways that students are interested in.

feeds.title: University of Aberdeen
feeds.description: Our students share their experiences at the university, study material, and helpful articles. We welcome staff and students of all backgrounds, and connect with our communities and partners, locally, nationally, and internationally. We offer a flexible and individual approach to your studies.
